correctness.rationale: Hensel root lifting gives a disjoint union of even-valuation square shells. The exact Fourier values follow from complete lift cancellation, unit-square Gauss sums and Legendre-sign multiplicities. Convolution proves sharp endpoint norms. Two geometric limits with summable O(p^-v) errors yield sigma_p. Direct full coefficient checks passed on twelve prime-power cases; Parseval and k=30,60 asymptotics also matched. Finite checks only corroborate the analytic all-depth proof.

Previously published valuation shell spectra have different operators and no absolute sum statement.

value.rationale: The complete square set is a canonical nonunit-enhanced Fourier frequency set. Its sharp Wiener norm is a natural harmonic invariant on the full tower, with a newly isolated linear-depth growth coefficient and two p mod 4 branches. Crucially, projection onto unit squares alone is depth invariant, showing the extra p-adic shell mechanism is essential rather than a renamed prime-field formula. The result is an all-parameter classification and not an arbitrary finite computation.
